triggers.fact: Razorpay is focusing on artificial intelligence-led products, international expansion, and new software offerings for its next phase of growth.
Razorpay's careers page actively advertises hiring for AI Builders across engineering and product teams.
Razorpay launched RAY, an AI-powered account manager on WhatsApp for businesses in partnership with IndusInd Bank.
Razorpay launched a Multi-Currency Account to enable exporters to receive settlements in foreign currencies.

pain_hypothesis: As Razorpay expands its AI-led product suite and international offerings, scaling campus hiring to find specialized tech talent across multiple engineering colleges creates operational friction in coordinating drives and evaluating candidates.
